## Main concepts

| Term       | Meaning                                                    |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| ObServe    | The application holding the source observation data.        |
| ROS form   | An Excel workbook for reporting observer data to the IOTC.  |
| Form model | A definition of the expected form structure and fields.     |
| Export     | The process of populating a ROS form from ObServe records.  |

## Data mapping

| Term            | Meaning                                                   |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| Source record   | Data read from the ObServe database.                       |
| Field mapping   | The source and transformation used to populate a field.    |
| Reference lookup | Matching a source value against a reference table.         |
| Finding         | A problem reported when validating the populated form.     |
